candidate_relations.reason: The record supports enhanced S-cone syndrome with childhood nyctalopia, absent rod ERG, and characteristic retinal changes; retinitis pigmentosa sine pigmento does not preserve the required ESCS subtype.

candidate_relations.reason: Cone-rod dystrophy typically emphasizes early cone dysfunction, whereas this case has preserved acuity and color vision with childhood nyctalopia and a flat rod ERG characteristic of ESCS.
Non-syndromic retinitis pigmentosa sine pigmento is not equivalent to enhanced S-cone syndrome, which is defined by its distinctive photoreceptor phenotype and ERG pattern.
candidate_relations.scope_detail: Related pigmentless retinal degeneration diagnosis but lacks and conflicts with the ESCS subtype.

candidate_relations.scope_detail: Broad retinal dystrophy category with an incompatible conventional subtype.
